resources.string: OpenCMR2 plays your copy of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 for PC. Copy its installation folder to this device, then choose it here. The game files are copied into the app, about 700 MB, only once.
The folder needs Game, FrontEnd and Sounds. You can also choose a folder that contains it. Files on a CD or ISO need to be installed or extracted first.
No complete game installation was found in this folder. It needs Game/Bigfiles/common.bfl, FrontEnd/common.bfl and Sounds/surface.bfl.
